# visualization.baseline_plot.plot_baseline_model { #fmrimod.visualization.baseline_plot.plot_baseline_model }

```python
plot_baseline_model(
    model,
    term=None,
    title=None,
    subtitle=None,
    caption=None,
    block_x='global',
    drift_scale='raw',
    figsize=None,
    line_width=1.2,
    term_name=None,
)
```

Plot the time-varying terms of a baseline model (R ``plot.baseline_model``).

One lane per term on a shared time axis: drift basis functions keep
their colour in every run, nuisance regressors keep the names you
supplied, and when those look like rigid-body motion parameters
translations and rotations get separate lanes (their units differ).
Each lane has a key at its right edge in column order (a legend below
the plot past seven series). Lines never cross runs. Terms constant
within every run (run intercepts, a global intercept) are left out and
listed in the caption; request one with ``term`` to draw it. For
spline and polynomial drift the caption gives a rough DCT-equivalent
high-pass period, ``2 x run duration / columns``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                  | Description                                                                                                                          | Default    |
|-------------|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| model       | BaselineModel         |                                                                                                                                      | _required_ |
| term        | str                   | One term to draw (``"drift"``, ``"block"`` or ``"nuisance"``; an exact or unique partial match). ``term_name`` is an alias.          | `None`     |
| title       | str                   | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                        | `None`     |
| subtitle    | str                   | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                        | `None`     |
| caption     | str                   | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                        | `None`     |
| block_x     | (\'global\', \'run\') | Runs concatenated on one time axis, or one column per run.                                                                           | `"global"` |
| drift_scale | (\'raw\', \'unit\')   | Plot drift as it enters the design, or divide each basis function by its peak within its run (the caption then gives the raw peaks). | `"raw"`    |
| figsize     | (float, float)        |                                                                                                                                      | `None`     |
| line_width  | float                 |                                                                                                                                      | `1.2`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description   |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------|
|        | matplotlib.figure.Figure |               |
